newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank's Feldt says Sweden should mull ERM.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank's Feldt says Sweden should mull ERM.

text.p: The chairman of the board of Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Thursday said Sweden was approaching a stage at which it should consider a fixed exchange rate policy for the crown.

"When we have achieved sufficient stability we should consider a fixed exchange rate policy," board chairman and former finance minister Kjell-Olof Feldt told Reuters, adding that Sweden was approaching such a situation.
"We should consider joining the Exchange Rate Mechanism regardless of when we join the EMU (Europe's Economic and Monetary Union)," Feldt said.

The crown did not need to be pegged in the exchange rate mechanism ERM for Sweden to qualify for EMU membership, Feldt said, and denied reports in Wednesday's business daily Finanstidningen that he had said so.
On the contrary, Feldt said he agreed with Riksbank governor Urban Backstrom that the decisive factor was the stability of the currency, not membership itself.
